data.content:
Order Flow

You can see the information about the order on the restaurant panel and also with the /food-orders/active endpoint. The status of the order is managed via verify, prepare, handover, deliver and cancel endpoints. Details on order management are as follows:

/food-orders/periodic/unapproved endpoint is queried to get unapproved orders.

These orders' status can be either 325 or 400 . 

  • 400 is for pre-approved scheduled orders or immediate orders. 
  • To approve use /verify.
  • 325 is for scheduled orders.
  •  To approve use /verify-scheduled.
  • Approved order's status is now 350 and cannot be queried with /unapproved endpoint anymore.
  • An hour before the order delivery time, the status field of the order is assigned as 500 and the status is automatically displayed as being prepared.
  • After this point, the order is no different from the immediate orders.

Flow continues according to the delivery type.

For orders to be delivered by the restaurant courier (deliveryType: 2), the flow is as follows:

  • /prepare is queried to make status as being prepared.
  • /deliver is queried to make status as delivered.

For the orders to be delivered by Getir courier (deliveryType: 1), the flow is as follows:

  • /prepare is queried to make status as being prepared.
  • /handover is queried to make status as delivered to Getir courier.
  • The steps after this period are handled by Getir courier .

There should be at least 1 minute interval between the call times of verify, prepare, deliver endpoints. After the verify is called, at least 1 minute should pass before a call to prepare can be sent. Same relation holds true for prepare and deliver endpoints.
